candidates_2026.endorsed_by: Krajina coalition backers at joint press event: Viliam Karas (KDH), Milan Krajniak (Kresťanská únia), Veronika Remišová (Za ľudí), Gábor Grendel (NOVA)

candidates_2026.name: JUDr. Ing. PhDr. Juraj Mravec, PhD., MBA
candidates_2026.prior_runs: 2025-09-06 by-election lost to Hrčka (Hrčka 78.58 %, so Mravec ~21.4 % by subtraction)
candidates_2026.profile: Lawyer, local councillor, 45; also runs for city/BSK councils as independent.

key_events.text: Hrčka gave up the mandate (effective 1 June 2025) taking political responsibility for a ~2.7 M EUR fraud by an employee of the district office.
By-election: Hrčka re-elected with 12,260 votes (78.58 % of valid votes) vs Juraj Mravec; turnout ~16 % of ~92,492 voters (figures as reported by Hrčka/TASR; official ŠÚ SR table not retrieved).
Hrčka announced re-election bid under the banner of the new party Krajina.

Krajina presented backers of its Bratislava candidates incl. Hrčka: Karas (KDH), Krajniak (KÚ), Remišová (Za ľudí), Grendel (NOVA); self-described centre-conservative alternative to Vallo's coalition.

Campaign escalates: Klimovský video likened Hrčka's attacks on PS to Smer rhetoric ('the mayor chose his side'); Hrčka accused him of dishonest campaigning and of digitally reddening his face in the video.
Petržalka also holds a local referendum on election day; ~96,500 eligible voters in 96 precincts.

notes: Hrčka is a heavy favourite on track record (77.19 % in 2022, 78.58 % in 2025 by-election) but 2026 is the first time he faces a Vallo-coalition nominee directly (in 2022 the coalition did not field a starosta candidate against him; PS/SaS/TB then won 33 of 35 council seats per ŠÚ SR, https://volby.statistics.sk/oso/oso2022/json/tab07/529460.json). The coalition now frames the race as anti-Smer; Krajina positions centre-right. Petržalka turnout is low (32.23 % in 2022, ~16 % in 2025 by-election); same-day local referendum and BA mayor race (Vallo vs Ráž) may lift turnout and help the coalition nominee. Non-scientific online vote on komunalne-volby.sk (20 self-selected votes, 2026-10-09) is NOT a poll and is excluded. 2018 result: Greksa flagged 'X' by ŠÚ SR (candidacy lapsed/withdrew). Mravec's 2025 share is derived (100 - 78.58), not officially sourced. POLLS/ODDS: no public scientific poll and no bookmaker odds found for this district as of 2026-10-20.
